touches.text: Code that is no longer needed is deleted. Git history keeps it if we ever need it back.
A device talks to other devices only over the bus, never by importing them.
The exceptions are client tools a device publishes:
A message is addressed to a name (a device instance), never to a connection. A shim that restarts reconnects and answers to the same name, so restarting it never restarts the bus.
Holds the charter tool's instance (17.6): build-quality feedback is hers.
charter: compiles a component's bounded state from its history. WHY: state is compiled from the component's tickets, never hand-edited (Law 5). Held by CodeMother.

data_recorder: a mailbox for feedback records until an inspection reads them; called a mailbox because for many recorders the data arrives over the bus. The records are JSON files under the holder that assembled it (~/.cairn/devices/<holder>/<n>/tools/data_recorder/), not a tree: the plainest thing that works. [why?]
WHY: Its purpose is different from the rest of the top-level things, which is why it stands on its own. It is not a device: only devices are on the bus.
